description: This file is a C header file declaring internal API functions for an HTTP Web Container Transact (HttpWcto) object, including functions for state management, request handling, processing, and internal notifications. It provides definitions for function prototypes used within the implementation files.

methods.name: HttpWctoGetBspIf
methods.description: Gets the BSP interface handle associated with the HTTP Webc Transact object.

methods.name: HttpWctoSetBspIf
methods.description: Sets the BSP interface handle for the HTTP Webc Transact object.

methods.name: HttpWctoGetHfpIf
methods.description: Retrieves the HFP interface handle.

methods.name: HttpWctoSetHfpIf
methods.description: Assigns the HFP interface handle.

methods.name: HttpWctoGetWebcSession
methods.description: Retrieves the Webc session handle.

methods.name: HttpWctoSetWebcSession
methods.description: Sets the Webc session handle.

methods.name: HttpWctoGetBmoReq
methods.description: Gets the BMO request message handle.

methods.name: HttpWctoSetBmoReq
methods.description: Sets the BMO request message handle.

methods.name: HttpWctoGetBmoRep
methods.description: Retrieves the BMO response message handle.

methods.name: HttpWctoSetBmoRep
methods.description: Sets the BMO response message handle.

methods.name: HttpWctoGetTcpSimpleClient
methods.description: Gets the TCP simple client handle.

methods.name: HttpWctoSetTcpSimpleClient
methods.description: Assigns the TCP simple client handle.

methods.name: HttpWctoGetTransState
methods.description: Retrieves the current transaction state.

methods.name: HttpWctoSetTransState
methods.description: Sets the transaction state.

methods.name: HttpWctoReturn
methods.description: Returns the Webc Transact object to a previous state or pool.

methods.name: HttpWctoReset
methods.description: Resets the Webc Transact object to its initial state.

methods.name: HttpWctoIsLastTrans
methods.description: Checks if the current transaction is the last one.

methods.name: HttpWctoDoLastTrans
methods.description: Performs operations for the last transaction.

methods.name: HttpWctoOpen
methods.description: Initializes or opens the Webc Transact object.

methods.name: HttpWctoClose
methods.description: Closes or releases resources associated with the object.

methods.name: HttpWctoAcquireAccess
methods.description: Acquires access to resources or locks necessary for operation.

methods.name: HttpWctoReleaseAccess
methods.description: Releases acquired resource locks.

methods.name: HttpWctoRequest
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request with specified method and URI.

methods.name: HttpWctoDoOptions
methods.description: Handles an HTTP OPTIONS method request.

methods.name: HttpWctoDoGet
methods.description: Handles an HTTP GET method request.

methods.name: HttpWctoDoHead
methods.description: Handles an HTTP HEAD method request.

methods.name: HttpWctoDoPost
methods.description: Handles an HTTP POST method request.

methods.name: HttpWctoDoPut
methods.description: Handles an HTTP PUT method request.

methods.name: HttpWctoDoDelete
methods.description: Handles an HTTP DELETE method request.

methods.name: HttpWctoDoTrace
methods.description: Handles an HTTP TRACE method request.

methods.name: HttpWctoDoConnect
methods.description: Handles an HTTP CONNECT method request.

methods.name: HttpWctoQuery
methods.description: Performs a query operation on the Webc Transact object.

methods.name: HttpWctoRecv
methods.description: Receives data over the connection.

methods.name: HttpWctoSend
methods.description: Sends data over the connection.

methods.name: HttpWctoFinish
methods.description: Finalizes or completes a transaction.
